purpose: acceptance of data -> signal -> portfolio target -> native orders -> ledger -> equity, not a return competition or investment recommendation

data_requirements.owner: ashare-data independent task; AQ consumes an immutable owner export, no collection or secondary store
data_requirements.calendar: authoritative exchange open sessions, including >=120 before start and the next open session after end; no weekday-generated calendar
data_requirements.securities: canonical security identifiers with listing/delisting evidence or explicitly qualified scoped listing model
data_requirements.daily_basis: unadjusted; prices CNY/share, volume shares; source precision retained
data_requirements.state_policy: AD must distinguish observed, derived, modeled and unavailable fields; unknown suspension/limits cannot silently become false or inferred +/-10%
data_requirements.corporate_actions: cash dividend record/ex/pay dates, cash amount, share changes/tradability within each execution window; explicit source-qualified coverage/absence required; gaps block economic acceptance
data_requirements.signal_basis: raw closing prices on the exchange calendar, including AD-provided suspension close values; never silently drop/forward-fill missing rows
data_requirements.pit: historical research only; no strict PIT claim
data_requirements.missing_policy: fail visibly by security/date/field; preserve all frozen questions/windows; no silent sample removal

execution.matching: same-session observed raw open under a daily opening-price research model, no intraday queue or liquidity claim
execution.target_formula: floor((previous committed equity * weight) / previous raw close / 100) * 100
execution.order_sequence: all negative target deltas first, then all positive deltas; within each side lexicographic security order; one shared native cash account
execution.unfilled: cancel at session end; retry only on next scheduled rebalance, recompute from actual holdings
execution.cash: native pre-trade cash and fee checks; never allow negative cash to imitate JQ anomalies

fees.scope: fixed acceptance cost model for all windows, not a statement of historical statutory rates

corporate_action_policy.dividend: gross cash credited on source pay_date; receivable from ex_date; withholding rate fixed zero for this acceptance model
corporate_action_policy.shares: source credit and tradable dates must equal ex_date; fractional shares round half up
corporate_action_policy.unsupported: rights issues, mergers, differing credit/tradability dates, and non-adjacent record/ex exchange dates fail visibly

strategies.title: 双家电日度等权跨分红
strategies.formula: each security weight=0.49; rebalance daily using prior committed equity and prior raw close; native gross dividend, zero withholding, 09:00 payment-date credit

acceptance.first_run: record pre-fix full outputs and failures before opening holdout results; no selecting passing dates or stocks
acceptance.publication: no raw JQ account/reference evidence in public git; no push/tag/release/deploy/live trading authorized
